testResults.name: strategy-contract
testResults.result: 4 tests passed for documented callback ordering, fill-before-on_fill portfolio mutation, subscribed-event filtering, deterministic context boundaries, seeded state, and class-plus-parameter binding.

testResults.name: focused-quality
testResults.result: Focused Ruff lint, format, and ty checks passed. The synchronous context uses injected clock, bus, venue, data, scheduler, and sinks without wall-clock, network, or process-global randomness.

decisions: Strategy callbacks are mode-independent and receive immutable events; runtime dependencies are constrained through StrategyContext.
The binding adapter accounts fills before delivering on_fill and filters events by strategy subscriptions and universe.
